exposure: Pregnant women with low family income
Inactive smoking women with low family income
Active and passive smoking women with lower levels of education
Pregnant women who did not receive information about the hazards of smoking
cohort: Singleton full-term pregnant women who gave birth at a university hospital in Jordan in June 2020
finding: Smoking during pregnancy is associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including increased risk of cesarean section and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
mod_finding: The risk for cesarean section was ninefold higher in nulliparous smoking women.
